piotroski.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/MRVL.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models

beneish_state.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/MRVL.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 183542126000.0 = SEC companyfacts diluted share count 847300000 (as of 2026-01-31) multiplied by the close 216.62 of 2026-08-28 from the repo's own market plane (data/market/MRVL.json), not an issuer document.

price_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/MRVL.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts revenue
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 183542126000.0 divided by fiscal year 2026-01-31 revenue 8194600000.

price_to_earnings.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/MRVL.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts net income
price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 183542126000.0 divided by fiscal year 2026-01-31 GAAP net income 2670100000.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/MRVL.json quality.derived.enterprise_value over SEC companyfacts revenue
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 184572226000.0 divided by fiscal year 2026-01-31 revenue 8194600000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 184572226000.0 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 1396400000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth. The discount rate and terminal growth are assumed, so the solve is an assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': 0.6167, '7': 0.4346, '10': 0.3117}). It measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a statement about price, and inherits the same assumed discount rate and terminal growth.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found or unusable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
Data tier (T1/T2/T3) describes data availability. Opportunity tier (O1/O2/O3) describes research priority. Neither implies the other.
